title: Consign dangerous goods only in licensed vehicles
what: Consign dangerous goods for transport only in vehicles licensed to carry them, where the Act requires a vehicle licence.

sources.title: Dangerous Substances (Dangerous Goods Transport) Regulations 2023 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not consign dangerous goods for transport in or on a vehicle if— (a) the vehicle is required to be licensed under the Act to transport the goods; and (b) the person knows, or ought reasonably to know, that the vehicle is not so licensed
